docstring: Traverses directed graph to detect cycles and compute all reachable ancestors for each node.
signature: def detect_dag_cycle_and_ancestors(nodes: list[str], edges: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> tuple[bool, dict[str, set[str]]]:
ref_test:
def test_dag_ancestors():
    nodes = ["A", "B", "C"]
    edges = [("A", "B"), ("B", "C")]
    has_cycle, anc = detect_dag_cycle_and_ancestors(nodes, edges)
    assert not has_cycle
    assert anc["A"] == set()
    assert anc["B"] == {"A"}
    assert anc["C"] == {"A", "B"}

    # Cycle test
    c_nodes = ["1", "2"]
    c_edges = [("1", "2"), ("2", "1")]
    has_c, _ = detect_dag_cycle_and_ancestors(c_nodes, c_edges)
    assert has_c is True
